comparison.objective: Clean a coil strainer and return its balancing valve to its original notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Service disassembly/cleaning and indexed valve repositioning.
comparison.success_condition: Strainer cleaned and balancing valve restored to the notch it originally occupied; body and cleanliness/pose thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Maintenance cleaning and indexed adjustment do not require hammer-driven notch separation, mandrel stabilization, or free-fragment containment.
